name: Obscuring Aether
oracle_text:
Face-down creature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
{1}{G}: Turn this enchantment face down. (It becomes a 2/2 creature.)
blocked_sentences: Face-down creature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
{1}{G}: Turn this enchantment face down. (It becomes a 2/2 creature.)

needs.what: an op that turns a permanent already on the battlefield face down (708.2), making it a nameless, typeless 2/2 colorless creature with no abilities that its controller may turn face up only if it has a morph/disguise cost (or, for a noncreature card, never)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: manifest, manifest_dread and the face_down option on look_at_top/search_library/reveal_until only put cards onto the battlefield face down from a library; nothing flips a permanent that is already on the battlefield, and animate/set_pt would leave its name, types and abilities in place

needs.what: a spell filter key on spell_cost_reduction's affects_spells matching a creature spell being cast face down (morph, disguise, or any other face-down cast)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cost_reduction's affects_spells reads printed characteristics (types, colors, not_from_zone, exclude_self); face_down exists only in battlefield selectors, so a face-down spell on the stack cannot be singled out
